description: Erection of a single storey side extension, conversion of garage into habitable room and replacement of front garage door with a window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( B-01 Rev K. Received on 21/01/2022; A-01 Rev L, A-02 Rev L, A-03 Rev L, A-04 Rev L, A-05 Rev L, A-06 Rev L, A-07 Rev L, B-01 Rev L & Fire Safety Strategy Rev L. Received on 27/01/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The accommodation hereby permitted shall only be occupied for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 22 Lela Avenue.
